title: Technology Protection Plan Fee Schedule (Student Technology Device Program)
content:
This schedule of the Student Technology Device Program sets, for each loan type, whether the loan carries the Technology Protection Plan, the annual plan fee per device, the share of that fee waived by meal status, the household ceiling on plan fees, the window for moving a standard-liability loan onto the plan, and whether the fee is credited when the device comes back during the year.

## Fee schedule

| Loan type | Carries the Technology Protection Plan | Annual plan fee per device (USD) | Share waived, any Free Meal Status tier | Share waived, any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier | Household ceiling on plan fees per school year, after waivers (USD) | Window to move a standard-liability loan onto the plan | Plan fee credited when the device is returned during the year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan (Standard Liability) | No | 0.00 | 100 percent | 50 percent | 75.00 | 30 calendar days | No |
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Yes | 25.00 | 100 percent | 50 percent | 75.00 | 30 calendar days | No |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Yes | 20.00 | 100 percent | 50 percent | 75.00 | 30 calendar days | No |
| Windows Laptop Loan (Standard Liability) | No | 0.00 | 100 percent | 50 percent | 75.00 | 30 calendar days | No |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | Yes | 40.00 | 100 percent | 50 percent | 75.00 | 30 calendar days | No |
| Mobile Hotspot Loan | No | 0.00 | 100 percent | 50 percent | 75.00 | 30 calendar days | No |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The plan fee is an annual fee per device; a loan type without the plan carries a fee of 0.00.
2. The waived shares are shares of the plan fee: all of it for a student holding any Free Meal Status tier, half of it for a student holding any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier.
3. The household ceiling is a maximum on the plan fees one household pays in one school year after the waivers, 75.00 for every loan type.
4. The enrollment window is counted in calendar days after checkout, the checkout date being day 0; it is 30 days for every loan type.
5. No loan type credits the plan fee when the device is returned during the year.

## Schedule figures at a glance

| Plan loan type | Fee | Fee after the Free Meal Status waiver | Fee after the Reduced-Price Meal Status waiver |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chromebook Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 25.00 | 0.00 | 12.50 |
| iPad Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 20.00 | 0.00 | 10.00 |
| Windows Laptop Loan with Technology Protection Plan | 40.00 | 0.00 | 20.00 |
